purpose: Freeze one source-supported, non-overlapping structural candidate: compose the Phase73 source-exact finite-pc pseudorange miss mask with the existing opt-in receiver secondary-signal bias states.

selection_basis.candidate: Phase73 finite in-domain base-pc pseudorange retention plus --native-signal-bias-states
selection_basis.source_gap: Phase73/76 native summaries have receiver_signal_bias_states=0, while the official fgo_gnss_imu.m passes each signal type to its pseudorange factor and the native backend already has a source-defined static secondary-code bias state path.

official_source.fgo_gnss_imu_evidence: PseudorangeFactor_XC receives sigtype for each observable; stop/pose and clock alternatives are separate official factors.

native_source_contract.eligibility: signal_policy::isSecondarySignal(system, signal); primary code is the clock reference and one static meter-valued state is attached per eligible (system, signal)
native_source_contract.factor_model: range + c*(epoch clock + constellation ISB) + static signal bias - corrected pseudorange
native_source_contract.bias_sign: positive state increases predicted secondary-code range; no raw sign or truth fit is introduced
native_source_contract.prior: zero-mean static prior sigma 1000 m, fixed in the existing native implementation and treated as a gauge regularizer
native_source_contract.scope: undifferenced FGO pseudorange factors only; no IFLC, base correction model change, truth coordinate, WLS, or precomputed trajectory

non_duplicates.phase46_clock: sealed common receiver-clock gauge/no-go; not reused
non_duplicates.phase60_intersignal_bias: sealed finite Full/Satellite ISB availability=0; not reused
non_duplicates.phase61_cn0_code_calibration: sealed raw CMC coverage/direction no-go; not reused
non_duplicates.phase20_stop: existing raw-IMU stop candidate already scored on one Pixel7pro route; not this pseudorange signal-bias composition
non_duplicates.phase73_miss_mask: the base-pc finite miss mask remains unchanged and is the control component, not relaxed

historical_phase11_reference.policy: source/structural provenance only; no Phase11 truth payload or score is an input or route selector

phase76_accuracy_result_record.status: no-go; candidate structural artifacts are not a Phase77 truth input

phase74_control_source.route_control_policy: Phase74 sealed route control pins are the exact Phase43 identity reference; no retyped hash table

cohort.raw_input_source: exact Phase65/70/73 Pixel5 raw device_gnss.csv, device_imu.csv, and brdc.nav pins; base.obs is the exact Phase64/65 station artifact

base_recipe.control_definition: Phase73 finite-pc miss-mask recipe with signal-bias flag absent
base_recipe.implementation_status: existing native opt-in source path is evaluated; no C++ source mutation is authorized by this freeze

candidate_contract.operation: retain Phase73 exact finite in-domain base pc behavior and attach one static meter-valued state to each eligible secondary (system, signal) pseudorange factor
candidate_contract.signal_bias_eligibility: signal_policy::isSecondarySignal only; no canonical-frequency aliasing, no cross-constellation or cross-satellite state
candidate_contract.secondary_families: all source-supported secondary SignalType values actually parsed by the Android loader; every state/factor key is reported
candidate_contract.pseudorange_population: Phase73 finite-pc miss mask remains authoritative; no fill/extrapolation/endpoint hold
candidate_contract.tdcp_doppler_imu_spp: no dedicated change; any secondary TDCP population change caused by the existing opt-in eligibility gate is reported and must be deterministic
candidate_contract.tuning: none after freeze or after any future truth read
forbidden: nav rerun outside the declared native process

truth_free_structural_gates.phase73_miss_mask_identity_definition: For every route, original_adopted_pseudorange_rows, retained_finite_pc_pseudorange_rows, dropped_missing_exact_stream_rows, dropped_out_of_domain_rows, dropped_nonfinite_correction_rows, retained_over_original_fraction, retained_finite_pc_fraction, correction_abs_p50_m, correction_abs_p95_m, and correction_abs_max_m must equal the sealed Phase73 control values byte-for-byte after the declared JSON numeric serialization. The candidate must not change the Phase73 miss-mask population or correction values.
truth_free_structural_gates.base_matched_adopted_factor_fraction: informational only; do not re-apply the historical 0.80 gate because the exact Phase73 population is frozen by identity
truth_free_structural_gates.base_finite_correction_fraction: informational only; do not re-apply the historical 0.99 gate because the exact Phase73 population is frozen by identity
truth_free_structural_gates.base_retained_finite_pc_fraction: must equal the sealed Phase73 value per route, not a new threshold

telemetry_required.state_grouping: route, GNSS system, SignalType; no presentation collapse

read_policy.native_or_solver_subprocess_policy: native invocation is allowed only in the separately sealed structural runner before any accuracy truth; no subprocess after truth

next_stage.only_if_structural_all_passed: create a new accuracy freeze and compare the immutable candidate against the exact Phase43 control and the Phase73 no-bias reference under the unchanged Phase44/76 Haversine metric
next_stage.if_structural_fail: no accuracy truth; preserve Phase43 champion, Phase73/77 opt-in experiments, and name the failed structural gate
next_stage.zero_point_782: not evaluated in this truth-free structural stage

fail_closed.any_truth_read: structural result is not scored and phase stops
